page.layout: One title page, centred: title lines in capitals, then an engraved emblem, then the imprint at the foot.
page.notes: Engraving between the title and the imprint: a female bust in a wreath with a cartouche of crossed rods below, no text. Handwritten inscription at the top edge (ownership note) omitted as handwriting. Last word of the penultimate line: the first letter is damaged; read as L (LAVVIENSEM, Brasławiensem), uncertain. Date printed as cIↄ. Iↄ. xc., transcribed as MDXC.
